Save a figure to a file

Source: R/graphics.R
save_figure.Rd

Opens the graphics device that matches the extension of file (.png, .tiff, .jpg, .pdf, .svg or .eps), evaluates the plotting code and closes the device. Raster formats carry the resolution in their header, as journals ask.

Usage

save_figure(
  file,
  expr,
  width = 16,
  height = 11,
  units = c("cm", "mm", "in"),
  res = 600,
  pointsize = 10
)

Arguments

file

Output file; its extension chooses the format.

expr

Plotting code, for instance plot(cmp); it is evaluated with the device open.

width, height

Size of the figure.

units

"cm", "mm" or "in".

res

Resolution in dots per inch of raster formats.

pointsize

Base size of the text, in points.

Value

The path of the file, invisibly.

Examples

fit <- design_anova(maize_nitrogen, "Yield_t_ha", "Nitrogen_kg_ha", block = "Block")
f <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
save_figure(f, plot(compare_means(fit, "Nitrogen_kg_ha")), width = 12, height = 9)
file.exists(f)
#> [1] TRUE
